scope_and_process.title: Scope and process
scope_and_process.description: Public design issue alignment, auto-close keyword scope, and release-note hygiene.

plugin_framework_contracts.title: Plugin framework contracts
plugin_framework_contracts.description: Core-vs-plugin import boundaries, extension-point separation, typed data-layer slots, factory validation, naming, and dead-code removal.

project_direction.title: Project direction
project_direction.description: Architectural boundaries across built-in runtimes, upstream signal producers, engine adapters, orchestrator-neutral endpoints, pool homogeneity, coordinator vs sidecar, Helm packaging, and upstream CRDs.

configuration_helm_and_compatibility.title: Configuration, Helm, and compatibility
configuration_helm_and_compatibility.description: Two-release deprecation windows, strict unknown-field decoding, safe defaults, shared Helm library templates, and lossless CRD conversion.

concurrency_and_shared_state.title: Concurrency and shared state
concurrency_and_shared_state.description: Mutex critical sections, bounded state with endpoint deletion cleanup, edge-triggered priority bands, drain-scoped contexts, per-replica state sync, and KV-event sequence recovery.

error_handling_and_boundaries.title: Error handling and boundaries
error_handling_and_boundaries.description: Boundary input validation, explicit error propagation without fabricated fallbacks, and unwrapped status-code mapping.

protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity.title: Protocol parsing and wire fidelity
protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity.description: Passthrough JSON fidelity, declarative route claims, complete SSE frame buffering, multi-API multimodal parity, host-port-rank endpoint keys, and disaggregated stage ordering.

performance_on_the_request_path.title: Performance on the request path
performance_on_the_request_path.description: Zero avoidable hot-path allocations, pooled transports and multiplexed event sockets, orthogonal load signals, contiguous prefix-cache scoring, and reproducible benchmarks.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Canonical metric subsystems and bounded label cardinality, single terminal request outcomes, package-scoped OpenTelemetry spans, and guarded debug logs.

testing_and_ci.title: Testing and CI
testing_and_ci.description: Production factory tests with exact output assertions, colocated sleep-free unit tests, and namespace-isolated E2E teardown.

security_and_trust_boundaries.title: Security and trust boundaries
security_and_trust_boundaries.description: Header namespacing and ingress/egress scrubbing, InferencePool SSRF target allowlists, TLS minimums, namespace-scoped watches, and sensitive payload redaction.

documentation_and_comments.title: Documentation and comments
documentation_and_comments.description: Colocated plugin READMEs, upstream guide linking, and review-round documentation synchronization.

scope_and_process#settle-design-tradeoff.consequence: Unaligned design changes stall in late review, and premature auto-close keywords close multi-slice tracking issues while work remains.

scope_and_process#use-none-release-notes.consequence: Internal churn in `release-note` blocks pollutes tag release notes, and stale PR descriptions misstate what merged.

plugin_framework_contracts#keep-core-run.consequence: Importing concrete plugins into core runtime packages creates import cycles and couples core dispatch to optional policies.

plugin_framework_contracts#separate-data.consequence: Mixing raw telemetry extraction with scoring or encoding soft preferences as hard filters causes premature endpoint elimination and duplicate state.

plugin_framework_contracts#exchange-cros.consequence: Sharing state via globals or undeclared attribute keys bypasses startup DAG validation and causes silent nil reads or aliasing across plugin instances.

plugin_framework_contracts#validate-plug.consequence: Deferring parameter checks past factory construction delays invalid-config failures until live traffic or allows post-init mutation races.

plugin_framework_contracts#name-plugin-p.consequence: Ambiguous plugin names and unitless block-count fields cause misconfigured thresholds when operators switch backend engines.

plugin_framework_contracts#share-common-.consequence: Duplicated helpers drift on edge cases, and stranded shims leave dead execution paths that mislead maintainers.

project_direction#keep-core-runtimes-bui.consequence: Adding single-purpose extension points bloats the framework interface, while hardcoding policies in core runtimes prevents operator opt-out.

project_direction#extract-scheduling-sig.consequence: Router-side schema translation drops model-specific fields, and mutable queue keys corrupt pre-admission priority ordering.

project_direction#configure-backend-engi.consequence: Inferring engine types from tangential flags or scattering engine conditionals across routing packages breaks multi-engine deployments.

project_direction#model-endpoints-with-o.consequence: Leaking Kubernetes `Pod` or controller types into discovery and `datalayer` interfaces blocks standalone non-Kubernetes deployments.

project_direction#scope-each-pool-to-a-s.consequence: Mixing base models or disaggregated roles inside one `InferencePool` invalidates pool-wide load, saturation, and KV-cache capacity assumptions.

project_direction#keep-client-conversati.consequence: Dropping stateful `/v1/responses` fields silently breaks multi-turn context, and placing multi-stage orchestration in pod sidecars expands workload-pod privileges.

project_direction#deploy-through-helm-ch.consequence: Adding ad-hoc CLI flags or diverging Kustomize production paths fragments operator configuration across deployment methods.

project_direction#consume-versioned-upst.consequence: Vendoring upstream CRDs or protobufs forks schemas from pinned Go module versions and masks upstream drift.

configuration_helm_and_compatibility#pro.consequence: Removing shipped flags, config fields, headers, or metrics without an `N+2` window breaks existing Helm upgrades and operator dashboards.

configuration_helm_and_compatibility#dec.consequence: Permissive YAML or JSON decoding silently ignores misspelled operator config fields and runs pods with unintended defaults.

configuration_helm_and_compatibility#shi.consequence: Enabling workload-sensitive heuristics or sidecar dependencies by default regresses baseline deployments and causes boot-order deadlocks.

configuration_helm_and_compatibility#ded.consequence: Copy-pasted Helm values drift across charts, and shell-based hooks fail at runtime inside distroless containers.

configuration_helm_and_compatibility#pre.consequence: Lossy CRD conversion drops fields during rolling upgrades across mixed API versions.

concurrency_and_shared_state#keep-mutex-.consequence: Holding mutexes across network I/O or channel sends stalls concurrent request routing and risks lock-order deadlocks.

concurrency_and_shared_state#bound-in-me.consequence: Unbounded session or endpoint maps leak memory under pod churn and route traffic using stale deleted-pod state.

concurrency_and_shared_state#reconcile-d.consequence: Idleness-based band sweeps race with arriving requests and drop queued work when active priority bands are deleted.

concurrency_and_shared_state#propagate-c.consequence: Ignoring `ctx.Err()` or server drain leaks background goroutines and strands capacity reservations after client disconnects.

concurrency_and_shared_state#scope-cross.consequence: Shared cross-replica keys or host clock comparisons let one restarting replica clobber peer load counters or stall startup.

concurrency_and_shared_state#recover-kv-.consequence: Applying KV-cache deltas across sequence gaps or worker restarts leaves phantom cached blocks in the prefix index.

error_handling_and_boundaries#validate-u.consequence: Unchecked untrusted payloads trigger panics or unbounded memory reads before domain logic runs.

error_handling_and_boundaries#propagate-.consequence: Fabricated fallback values route traffic on bogus capacity numbers, and request-path panics crash the router replica.

error_handling_and_boundaries#map-unwrap.consequence: Substring error matching breaks when messages change, and misclassified 4xx vs 5xx codes break client retry and gateway circuit-breaking.

protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity#prese.consequence: Full-struct JSON re-serialization strips vendor-specific sampling fields and rounds 64-bit integers via `float64`.

protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity#claim.consequence: Hardcoded endpoint paths in core dispatchers block custom engine routes that should pass through untouched.

protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity#buffe.consequence: Parsing raw TCP read chunks as whole SSE frames corrupts split JSON events, double-counts tokens, or hides truncated streams.

protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity#maint.consequence: API-skewed parsers or parallel multimodal slices misindex mixed-media prompts and bypass token accounting on newer endpoints.

protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity#key-e.consequence: Keying endpoint state by pod IP alone collides data-parallel worker ranks sharing one pod network namespace.

protocol_parsing_and_wire_fidelity#order.consequence: Leaking prefill-only fields into decode payloads or continuing after upstream stage failure wastes GPU decode capacity on broken requests.

performance_on_the_request_path#avoid-he.consequence: Per-request heap allocations and repeated map lookups inflate GC pause pressure and router p99 latency under high QPS.

performance_on_the_request_path#reuse-po.consequence: Per-scrape HTTP transports and duplicate ZMQ sockets exhaust ephemeral ports and add handshake overhead.

performance_on_the_request_path#evaluate.consequence: Scoring unfiltered endpoints wastes CPU and skews normalization, while leaked in-flight increments permanently starve healthy pods.

performance_on_the_request_path#score-pr.consequence: Crediting non-contiguous blocks overestimates KV-cache reuse, and deterministic tie-breaking herds shared-prefix traffic onto one pod.

performance_on_the_request_path#gate-rou.consequence: Unbenchmarked scoring or lock changes regress throughput or tail latency on cache-miss workloads without detection.

observability#register-metrics-under-can.consequence: Unbounded label values or orphaned pod series explode Prometheus cardinality and break shared dashboard queries.

observability#record-at-most-one-termina.consequence: Double-recording error paths inflates failure rates, and recording bypassed zero-cost stages skews latency histograms downward.

observability#acquire-package-scoped-ote.consequence: Dropping W3C trace headers or placing raw URLs in span names breaks distributed traces across stages and explodes trace cardinality.

observability#guard-per-item-debug-loops.consequence: Unguarded per-candidate formatting allocates on every request even when debug logging is disabled, and uncapped state dumps stall debug endpoints.

testing_and_ci#exercise-production-facto.consequence: Constructing internal structs directly in tests bypasses factory defaults and strict config decoding, letting broken wiring pass CI.

testing_and_ci#colocate-unit-tests-and-s.consequence: Fixed `time.Sleep` calls and close-then-rebind port helpers cause flaky unit tests under CI CPU contention.

testing_and_ci#isolate-parallel-end-to-e.consequence: Shared E2E namespaces or early-aborting teardown scripts collide parallel CI jobs and strand leaked cluster resources.

security_and_trust_boundaries#namespace-.consequence: Unscrubbed client routing headers allow external callers to spoof internal endpoint selection or leak pod topology on responses.

security_and_trust_boundaries#allowlist-.consequence: Dialing unverified header-derived targets or permitting CR/LF characters exposes decode and EPP pods to SSRF and HTTP request smuggling.

security_and_trust_boundaries#enforce-tl.consequence: Missing read timeouts expose listeners to slow-header DoS, cluster-wide watches over-privilege service accounts, and unredacted logs leak user prompts.

documentation_and_comments#colocate-plug.consequence: Scattered plugin docs or hardcoded source line links drift from code defaults and mislead operators.

documentation_and_comments#synchronize-d.consequence: Review-round renames that leave stale YAML examples or docstrings cause copy-paste configuration failures.
